## Bio

Hey! I'm Aditya, a Computer Science & Data Analytics student at IIT Patna focused on machine learning and quantitative finance.

I am pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science & Data Analytics at IIT Patna (Expected 2029), with coursework in Statistics, Time Series Analysis, Machine Learning, and Financial Modeling.

I build end-to-end predictive systems for finance and supply chains. Run projects to explore my featured work.

I maintain a practical algorithm and DSA practice workflow through my LeetCode solutions archive.

Currently focused on Python, financial modeling, and algorithmic trading foundations while improving production-ready ML deployment skills.

My toolkit includes Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, Prophet, SQL, Postgres, Airflow, and Streamlit. Run skills for details.

Previously worked as a Primary School Teacher at Gautam Bright School (July 2023 - March 2025), where I developed strong communication and leadership skills.

I enjoy bridging coding and markets by turning noisy, large datasets into deployable decision systems.

If you're working on data-driven finance or forecasting systems, feel free to connect.

## All projects (3 total)

- AI Time-Series Regime Detection System — Production-grade regime detection for high-dimensional time-series data using HMM + KMeans and XGBoost transition prediction.

Key outcomes:
- 65-75% transition prediction accuracy
- 17+ years of data processed
- +56% improvement in risk-adjusted performance
- Streamlit deployment for live monitoring and risk heatmaps

- Retail Demand Forecasting & Inventory Optimization — End-to-end SKU-level next-week demand forecasting pipeline combining Prophet + XGBoost with rule-based reorder recommendations.

Highlights:
- Airflow ETL for retail data pipelines
- Postgres-backed analytical workflows
- Backtesting across multiple regions and market conditions
- Dashboard experience using Streamlit/React

- LeetCode Solutions Archive — A structured, ongoing archive of algorithmic problem solving with focus on graph algorithms, dynamic programming, trees, and heaps.
